name: Patch Map
description: A benchmark to evaluate occupancy grid mapping algorithms' accuracy and robustness for environment representation in driving scenarios.
evaluation_method: Intersection-over-Union (IoU) and precision/recall on occupancy grids
reputation: A niche academic benchmark from the IROS literature used in research on occupancy-grid and patch-based mapping, but not a widely adopted large-scale community standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on occupancy-grid mapping; relatively specialized/small-scale compared to modern driving datasets; evaluation protocols vary between papers.
